title: Carne de Vinho e Alhos: Madeira's Wine and Garlic Pork, Explained
description: Carne de vinho e alhos is Madeira's wine and garlic marinated pork. How it is made, when it is eaten, what to order with it and where to taste it in Funchal.
heroAlt: Glasses of wine raised against a Madeira sunset aboard a private boat
